answer.reason: The verses tell of Ezekiel's vision by the Chebar, the valley of dry bones and the death of his wife, which add to the summary of his office and father.

clauses.english: saw the heavens opened and visions of God by the river Chebar
clauses.quote: the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God

clauses.english: was set down in a valley of dry bones and prophesied, and they lived
clauses.quote: the breath came into them, and they lived

clauses.english: lost his wife and was forbidden to mourn, as a sign to Israel
clauses.quote: at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

doubts: Many other verses marked in the passage are only the address 'Son of man' to Ezekiel or his commands, and I did not use them.
His call (EZK 2-3), the eating of the roll, the sign-acts and the temple vision could also have been chosen; I kept only the three clearest events.
